notes.title: Beta Test officially opens NOW!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone! Peekazoo is a party game that we've developed recently and is being tested on Steam currently.
In order to make the game better, we would like to invite you to test it and give us any feedback.
As it is a multiplayer online game, players are expected to be able to enter the game from 10-11am and 9-11pm on the 26th and 27th, June.
 
Go and check our game on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1652000/Peekazoo/ ! Hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: Open Beta Test soooooon!
notes.notes:
Are you ready to start a hide-and-seek party?
Peekazoo will launch its Open Beta Test on June 25th! 
Please stay tuned!
